versions.line: Claudopus installs with one line in Terminal
A task that asks you one question after another keeps every one on its card, each with its own buttons
The chat passes on a task's result as it did before 0.2.274
A task that ends its step while a command you allowed runs (such as a release Claude Code blocked) now…
Each reply in a task's chat, and its result, has a Copy button that copies the whole text
Each card of the bar above the prompt now has a small chart of that figure's last 10 minutes
Typing "allow", "yes", "release it" or a button's own words in the chat now answers the card that waits…
Each topic now has a short page a task reads first and a history that tasks only add to
Claudopus keeps a ledger of every task on disk as it changes
The panel's list no longer goes blank with "Claudopus couldn't show this tab" when you widen it with a lot…
The update message in the panel header is shorter, "v0.2.267 ready
claudopus.ai's cookie banner now just asks "Accept cookies?", and shows only in the EU and the EEA, the UK
However many tasks run, Claude's commands now leave two cores of your Mac free for you
Stats opens at once. It keeps what it has added up, by chat, by day and by month
Claudopus no longer sends the chat a message of its own when a task hands in a part of its result
The Leaderboard tab shows the board as a table with headings, the first three places in gold
Join on the leaderboard answers at once
The Leaderboard tab has three switches once you've joined
A link to your own leaderboard page now always previews as your card, with your name, figures and picture
Joining the leaderboard now says, one short line each, what the board shows, what is never sent
The panel's Leaderboard button now opens a Leaderboard tab
A link to someone's leaderboard page now shows a picture of their stats wherever you paste it
A leaderboard on claudopus.ai
Release it is the only press a release needs
The website's home page says the same things in about a third of the words
When a task hands you a part of its result, the task itself now tells the chat
The website's home page now opens with what you get
When a task asks you for a key, the box to paste it into is on its card at once, with the task's question
The Claudopus tab always stays first in the panel's row of tabs
A task's Details now shows what it does as it happens, at the end of its conversation
